notes.nsaba: Alipi: I pray, I ask; also “please”.

tips.title: Ilipi oni Edeke
body: **Edeke** is God; **akilip** to pray or ask, so **Alipi** is both “I pray” and “please”. **Edeke kiinak iyoŋ aijar!** is “God bless you!”.

tips.title: Ekrisimas ejokan!
body: Holidays take **ejokan** (good): **Ekrisimas ejokan!**, **Epasaka ejokan!**, **Eidi ejokan!**. **Asikukuu** is a holiday.

culture.title: Faith in Teso
body: Most Iteso are Christian, Catholic or Anglican, with Muslim communities in the towns. Ngora and Soroti have old mission churches and schools.
